title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Backup and Disaster Recovery Plan > Responsibilities

The Engineering Manager owns the plan. The on-call engineer declares a disaster and the founder is informed within 30 minutes.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Access Control Policy > Emergency access

In an incident, the on-call engineer may take emergency production access for up to 2 hours without prior approval. The Engineering Manager must approve it retrospectively within 24 hours.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Access Control Policy > Role-based access

Access to internal tools is defined by role: Founder, Engineering Manager, Engineer, Intern. A role template lists which applications each role may have and at what risk level.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Security Whitepaper > Secure development

Engineers complete secure coding training once a year. Secrets are stored in AWS Secrets Manager and are never committed to source control; a secrets scanner blocks any commit that contains one.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Incident Response Plan > On-call

A 24x7 on-call rotation covers P1 and P2 incidents. The rotation has four engineers, each on call for one week at a time.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Access Control Policy > Risk levels and approvals

Low risk applications (for example design and note-taking tools) are approved automatically if the requester's role allows them.Medium risk applications need approval from the person's manager.High risk applications, including AWS production, need approval from the Engineering Manager.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Access Control Policy > Access reviews

Access reviews run every quarter. Managers confirm or remove each person's access, and the Engineering Manager signs off the review.

content:

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Onboarding and Offboarding Procedure > Before the first day

A background check (identity, employment history and education) is completed before the start date for every employee, intern and contractor.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Onboarding and Offboarding Procedure > Contractors and interns

Contractors and interns follow the same procedure. Their access ends automatically on the contract end date unless extended in writing.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Backup and Disaster Recovery Plan > Testing

Restores are tested every quarter. The most recent restore test was on 12 September 2026 and was completed in 2 hours 40 minutes, within the 4-hour RTO. Results are reviewed by the Engineering Manager and filed in the evidence folder.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Vendor Management Policy > Due diligence

Before a Tier 1 vendor is onboarded, Nimbus Labs reviews its security reports (for example SOC 2 or ISO 27001), signs a data processing agreement and records the review in the vendor register. The Engineering Manager approves every Tier 1 vendor.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Security Whitepaper > Logging and monitoring

Security-relevant events are sent to a central log store and alerts are reviewed by the on-call engineer. Alerts for impossible-travel sign-ins and repeated failed logins are routed to the on-call engineer immediately.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Onboarding and Offboarding Procedure > Onboarding

A company laptop is issued with mobile device management (MDM) installed and disk encryption enforced.Accounts are created from the person's role template; additional access is requested through the access request process.Security awareness training must be completed within 7 days of joining. Access to production systems is not available until it is complete.Everyone signs a confidentiality agreement and the acceptable use policy.Annual refresher training is required for all staff.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Encryption Standard > Key management

Encryption keys are created and stored in AWS KMS.Keys are rotated every 365 days.Access to key administration is limited to two named engineers and is logged.Nimbus Labs does not operate its own hardware security module (HSM); it relies on the AWS KMS service.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Security Whitepaper > Network and application security

Production runs in private subnets; only the load balancer is internet-facing.A web application firewall filters all inbound traffic.Every code change is peer-reviewed by at least one other engineer before it can be merged.Static code analysis and dependency scanning run on every pull request.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs SOC 2 Type II Summary > Scope boundaries

The report covers the production platform hosted on AWS (Mumbai primary, Singapore disaster recovery), the corporate identity provider and the ticketing system. It does not cover customer-operated systems.

content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Vendor Management Policy > Sub-processors

Nimbus Labs uses 9 sub-processors that may process customer data, including AWS and an email delivery provider. The current list is shared with customers on request.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Security Whitepaper > Authentication

Employees sign in through our identity provider using SAML 2.0 single sign-on. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for every employee account with no exceptions. Customer administrators can connect their own SAML 2.0 identity provider to Nimbus Ledger Sync.
